changes.to: Android: the switches are a dialog from the app's Language packs row (kept in the app's SharedPreferences, applied when the keyboard comes up). macOS: there is no settings window, so the switches are check-marked items in the input menu in the menu bar (UserDefaults languagesOff). Turning off the last language is refused (Android: a short message; macOS: the item is greyed out). A language turned off still keeps its pack installed.
